title: Code Text Document Export
description: Add a language label to your source code and download a plain text document (.txt). PDF generation is not available.
intro: Code Text Document Export adds a language label to source text and prepares a .txt download. It does not create PDF bytes, paginate a document, highlight code for print, or render an image. Use the resulting text in your own editor or publishing workflow if another document format is required.
audience: Developers and technical writers saving short labelled source excerpts
input: A code excerpt and a source-language label that should appear above the text in the downloaded document.
outcome: A plain text document with a heading, the chosen language label, and the supplied source; the download has a .txt extension.
review: Check the language label and source content before sharing. Any PDF layout, printing, or syntax highlighting must be performed separately.
bestFor: Simple text handoffs, small code notes, and documentation drafts that only need a language label rather than a formatted PDF.
steps: Choose the source language used to label the text.
Paste the source excerpt or load it from a supported text file.
Choose Prepare Text Document and inspect the labelled output.
Download code-document.txt or copy it into your own document workflow.
useCases: Attaching a labelled JavaScript excerpt to a text note.
Saving a SQL example alongside review comments in a local folder.
Handing a short source sample to a technical writer.
Preparing raw text for an editor that will handle final document formatting.
commonMistakes: Expecting the .txt download to be a PDF file.
Changing the file extension to .pdf without converting its contents.
Assuming the tool supplies pagination or syntax highlighting for print.
tips: The language selection adds a label; it does not transform the code.
Open the downloaded file as plain text.
Use your document editor for any print layout or PDF export.
Check the source excerpt again before sharing it outside your project.

faq.question: Does this create a PDF?
faq.answer: No. It creates plain text and downloads code-document.txt. PDF generation is not implemented.

faq.question: Why does the address still contain code-to-pdf?
faq.answer: The existing address is retained for old links, while the visible name and output now describe the available text export.

faq.question: Can renaming the download make it a PDF?
faq.answer: No. A PDF requires PDF-encoded content. Use a document editor or other conversion tool for that step.

faq.question: Does choosing a language format the code?
faq.answer: No. The selected language is written as a document label; the source is included as text.

faq.question: Is the text stored on a server?
faq.answer: The text document is prepared in your browser and downloaded locally. This workspace has no account or saved document history.
